title: Open the app overview and text reader
acceptance:
**Story or goal** · Inspect an app and find its files.

**Expected behaviour** · Show the name, path and optional brief. Offer Browse files and Open README when present. Give both overview and reader direct routes.

**Scope boundary** · Read text from the member’s private home.

**Previous in delivery queue** · WI-032

**Depends on** · WI-028, WI-032

**Verify** · Open a direct overview URL, read the README, refresh/reconnect and press Back. Verify absent README and focus restoration.

**Effort basis** · Reuses established routes and file client.
evidence: /app/Weather and /file/Weather/README.md load directly after reconnect; Back focuses Open README, then Open on the revealed card. An app without a README (Bulk-01) offers Browse files as the only content action. A deleted file shows `This file is not available`; deleting it while open and pressing Back focuses the parent heading with a reachable Home. Evidence: qa/sprint-3/WI-033/. Owner accepted PI-02 on 27 November 2026.
